call.text: H‑Net’s hierarchy is created by a dynamic‑chunking layer that includes a routing module for drawing chunk boundaries and a downsampler that retains vectors at those boundary indicators, reducing sequence length while preserving semantically important positions [HNET:1:c012]. The model can apply this dynamic chunking iteratively, forming two nested stages (S=2) as shown in the architectural overview [HNET:1:c012]. H‑Net (2‑stage) is significantly better than H‑Net (1‑stage), demonstrating that adding a second dynamic‑chunking stage improves performance [HNET:3.1:c049].
